title: Updates
auto: Check for updates when Sextant starts
notConfigured: Updates are turned off in this build: it has no update signing key (plugins.updater.pubkey in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json). Download new versions from the release page.

manual.deb: Sextant was installed from a .deb package, so it does not replace itself. Download the new .deb from the release page and install it with your package manager, for example: sudo apt install ./Sextant_{{version}}_amd64.deb
manual.rpm: Sextant was installed from an .rpm package, so it does not replace itself. Download the new package from the release page and install it with your package manager.
manual.other: This copy of Sextant was not installed from a release package (AppImage, .dmg or .msi), so it cannot update itself. Download the new version from the release page.

error.network: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates. Check your internet connection or proxy and try again.
error.noRelease: The latest release on GitHub has no update for this system yet. Try again later.
error.signature: The downloaded update is not signed with the Sextant release key, so it was not installed.
error.networkInstall: Could not download the update. Check your internet connection or proxy and try again.
